property_summary: For any callee address and calldata, calling forward will succeed iff the callee's low-level call returns true; the reference forwards to the provided callee (so succeeds when that callee's call succeeds) but the mutant always calls address(0) which causes the call to fail for some callee calldata — so there exist inputs where reference returns true but mutant reverts.
change_summary: Swap the call to a failing built-in by calling a zero address which will revert the call, causing forward to revert when original might have succeeded.
